articles.headline: No. 3 USC women storm past Charleston as Hall, Davidson and Watkins power another blowout
articles.description: — Saniyah Hall and Jazzy Davidson scored 24 points each, JuJu Watkins added 20 and No. 3 Southern California routed Charleston 105-44 on Tuesday night.

articles.headline: No. 25 Nebraska women cruise past North Carolina A&T 76-35
articles.description: — Britt Prince made four 3-pointers and finished with 24 points to lead No. 25 Nebraska to a 76-35 victory over North Carolina A&T on Tuesday night.
